title: Combination of Donepezil and Memantine Attenuated Cognitive Impairment Induced by Mixed Endocrine-Disrupting Chemicals: an In Silico Study.
one_liner_zh: 该文用AutoDock Vina等工具研究药物组合对抗内分泌干扰物所致认知障碍的分子机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Little is known about the effects of endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) and the combination of memantine and donepezil on the pathogenesis of cognitive impairment. Here, we aimed to identify in silico the molecular mechanisms of the combination of memantine and donepezil that combat cognitive impairment induced by nine common EDCs using GeneMania, AutoDock Vina, Metascape, SwissADME, MIENTURNET, and miRNAsong. We observed that the mixture of memantine and donepezil had therapeutic effects on mixed EDC-induced cognitive impairment via five genes (TNF, ACHE, BAX, IL1B, and CASP3). With ACHE and TNF, donepezil and memantine both had a high docking score, respectively. The predominant connections among five mutual genes were physical interactions (77.6%). The major pathways associated with memantine and donepezil countering cognitive impairment generated by mixed EDCs were discovered to be "AGE-RAGE signaling pathway in diabetic complications," "pro-survival signaling of neuroprotectin D1," and "non-alcoholic fatty liver disease." The miRNAs and transcription factors implicated in memantine and donepezil protecting against mixed EDCs were hsa-miR-128-3p and hsa-miR-34a-5p, NFKB1, NFKB2, IRF8, and E2F4. The sponges' tertiary structure predictions for two major miRNAs were provided. The physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties of memantine and donepezil highlighted the need for a therapeutic combination of these medications to treat cognitive impairment.
abstract_zh: 关于内分泌干扰化学物（EDCs）以及美金刚与多奈哌齐联合使用对认知障碍发病机制的影响知之甚少。在此，我们旨在通过GeneMania、AutoDock Vina、Metascape、SwissADME、MIENTURNET和miRNAsong，在计算机模拟中识别美金刚与多奈哌齐联合对抗九种常见EDCs诱导的认知障碍的分子机制。我们观察到，美金刚与多奈哌齐的混合物通过五个基因（TNF、ACHE、BAX、IL1B和CASP3）对混合EDCs诱导的认知障碍具有治疗作用。多奈哌齐和美金刚分别与ACHE和TNF具有较高的对接分数。五个共同基因之间的主要连接为物理相互作用（77.6%）。发现与美金刚和多奈哌齐对抗混合EDCs诱导的认知障碍相关的主要通路为“糖尿病并发症中的AGE-RAGE信号通路”、“神经保护素D1的促生存信号”和“非酒精性脂肪肝病”。涉及美金刚和多奈哌齐保护免受混合EDCs影响的miRNAs和转录因子包括hsa-miR-128-3p和hsa-miR-34a-5p，以及NFKB1、NFKB2、IRF8和E2F4。提供了两个主要miRNAs的海绵三级结构预测。美金刚和多奈哌齐的理化及药代动力学特性强调了这些药物联合治疗认知障碍的必要性。
